title: GPU Accelerated Operations
summary: This module provides core functionalities for accelerating machine learning operations using various GPU backends, including BLAS, Apple Metal, and Vulkan. It handles device initialization, graph computation, data transfer, and optimization specific to each GPU architecture.

nodes.label: Initialize BLAS Backend
nodes.title: BLAS Backend Init
nodes.description: Initializes the BLAS backend for a specific device, preparing it for linear algebra operations.

nodes.label: Compute BLAS Graph
nodes.title: BLAS Graph Computation
nodes.description: Executes a computation graph using BLAS-accelerated operations like matrix multiplication and outer products.

nodes.label: Set BLAS Thread Count
nodes.title: Configure BLAS Threads
nodes.description: Configures the number of threads used by the BLAS backend for parallel execution.

nodes.label: Get BLAS Device Properties
nodes.title: Query BLAS Device Info
nodes.description: Retrieves properties and capabilities of a BLAS-enabled device.

nodes.label: Optimize Metal Graph
nodes.title: Metal Graph Optimization
nodes.description: Optimizes a computation graph for efficient execution on Apple's Metal GPU, including node fusion and reordering.

nodes.label: Encode Metal Operation
nodes.title: Metal Op Encoding
nodes.description: Encodes a specific operation for execution on the Metal backend, potentially with debug group information.

nodes.label: Initialize Metal Backend
nodes.title: Metal Backend Init
nodes.description: Initializes the overall Metal backend context for GPU operations.

nodes.label: Initialize Metal Device
nodes.title: Metal Device Init
nodes.description: Initializes the Metal backend for a specific GPU device.

nodes.label: Set Metal Abort Callback
nodes.title: Metal Abort Handler
nodes.description: Registers a callback function to be invoked if a Metal operation aborts.

nodes.label: Check Metal Family Support
nodes.title: Metal Device Family Check
nodes.description: Determines if the Metal backend supports a particular device family.

nodes.label: Capture Metal Compute
nodes.title: Metal Compute Capture
nodes.description: Enables capturing of the next Metal compute command for debugging or profiling purposes.

nodes.label: Get Metal Device Properties
nodes.title: Query Metal Device Info
nodes.description: Retrieves detailed properties and capabilities of a Metal GPU device.

nodes.label: Get Metal Buffer Type
nodes.title: Metal Buffer Type Query
nodes.description: Determines the optimal buffer type (e.g., shared or private memory) for a Metal device.

nodes.label: Compute Vulkan Graph
nodes.title: Vulkan Graph Computation
nodes.description: Executes a computation graph on a Vulkan-enabled GPU, managing command buffers and submissions.

nodes.label: Get Tensor (Async, Vulkan)
nodes.title: Async Vulkan Tensor Read
nodes.description: Asynchronously retrieves tensor data from Vulkan device memory to host memory.

nodes.label: Set Tensor (Async, Vulkan)
nodes.title: Async Vulkan Tensor Write
nodes.description: Asynchronously transfers tensor data from host memory to Vulkan device memory.

nodes.label: Copy Tensor (Vulkan Buffer)
nodes.title: Vulkan Buffer Tensor Copy
nodes.description: Performs a synchronous copy of tensor data between two Vulkan buffers.

nodes.label: Copy Tensor (Async, Vulkan)
nodes.title: Async Vulkan Tensor Copy
nodes.description: Asynchronously copies tensor data between Vulkan buffers.

nodes.label: Set Tensor (Vulkan Buffer)
nodes.title: Vulkan Buffer Tensor Write
nodes.description: Synchronously writes tensor data to a specific offset within a Vulkan buffer.

nodes.label: Get Tensor (Vulkan Buffer)
nodes.title: Vulkan Buffer Tensor Read
nodes.description: Synchronously reads tensor data from a specific offset within a Vulkan buffer.

nodes.label: Initialize Vulkan Device
nodes.title: Vulkan Device Init
nodes.description: Initializes the Vulkan backend for a specific GPU device, setting up contexts and queues.

nodes.label: Get Vulkan Buffer Type
nodes.title: Vulkan Buffer Type Query
nodes.description: Determines the default buffer type for a given Vulkan device.

nodes.label: Get Vulkan Host Buffer Type
nodes.title: Vulkan Host Buffer Type Query
nodes.description: Determines the buffer type suitable for host-visible memory on a Vulkan device.

nodes.label: Check Vulkan Op Support
nodes.title: Vulkan Operation Support
nodes.description: Checks if a specific GGML operation is supported for execution on the Vulkan device.

nodes.label: Get Registered Vulkan Device
nodes.title: Retrieve Vulkan Device
nodes.description: Retrieves a specific registered Vulkan device by index.

nodes.label: Free Vulkan Backend
nodes.title: Vulkan Backend Cleanup
nodes.description: Frees all resources associated with a Vulkan backend context.

nodes.label: Memset Vulkan Tensor
nodes.title: Vulkan Tensor Memory Set
nodes.description: Sets a region of a Vulkan tensor's memory to a specified byte value.

nodes.label: Write Non-Contiguous (Async, Vulkan)
nodes.title: Async Non-Contiguous Write
nodes.description: Asynchronously writes non-contiguous tensor data from host to a Vulkan buffer, optimizing for slices.

nodes.label: Clear Vulkan Buffer
nodes.title: Vulkan Buffer Clear
nodes.description: Clears the entire content of a Vulkan buffer with a specified byte value.

nodes.label: Get Vulkan Device Count
nodes.title: Query Vulkan Device Count
nodes.description: Returns the total number of available Vulkan-compatible GPU devices.

nodes.label: Synchronize Vulkan Operations

nodes.description: Waits for all pending Vulkan commands and operations to complete on the GPU.

nodes.label: Allocate Vulkan Buffer

nodes.description: Allocates a new buffer on the Vulkan device with a specified size.

nodes.label: Get Vulkan Device Properties
nodes.title: Query Vulkan Device Info
nodes.description: Retrieves detailed properties and capabilities of a Vulkan GPU device.

nodes.label: Free Vulkan Host Buffer
nodes.title: Vulkan Host Buffer Cleanup
nodes.description: Frees a host-allocated buffer associated with the Vulkan backend.

nodes.label: Wait for Vulkan Events
nodes.title: Vulkan Event Wait
nodes.description: Waits for a set of Vulkan events to be signaled before proceeding.

nodes.label: Free Vulkan Buffer
nodes.title: Vulkan Buffer Cleanup

nodes.label: Optimize Vulkan Graph
nodes.title: Vulkan Graph Optimization
nodes.description: Optimizes a computation graph for Vulkan execution, including node reordering and fusion patterns.

nodes.label: Test Vulkan Dequantization
nodes.title: Vulkan Dequantization Test
nodes.description: Performs performance and correctness tests for dequantization operations on the Vulkan backend.

nodes.label: Shader Generator Entry

nodes.description: Compiles a GLSL shader source file into a SPIR-V binary format for Vulkan execution.
